notes: The sandbox reference is an unpinned bootstrap build (--allow-unpinned-reference); build-metadata asserts commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm.
Float-sensitive tests are gated to linux-x64 as a precaution; no macOS arm64 run was available, so no macOS difference is measured.
Mutation checks: double luma lerp fails 4 gated tests; double HSL fails the colour-ramp test.

Setup: sandbox default Node v22 failed the bootstrap Node 24 check; used preinstalled /opt/node24 (v24.22.3). Bootstrap (npm, submodule, reference) 199 s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry test 67 s.
